summary: Gate the conformance suite in CI

delivery.outcome: Every pull request and every push to the default branch runs the normative conformance suite, so a contract that subactor/twin already pins cannot regress unobserved
nonGoals: No change to the standard, the reference blueprint or the conformance rules themselves
No new runtime dependency; the suite stays dependency-free and offline
No workflow that publishes, deploys or acquires any credential
No change to the managed governance workflow or the adopted package

architecture.decision: Publish the workflow authored locally as `ci: require Lifecycle DSL conformance`, cherry-picked with its original authorship, and repin its actions to the exact Node 24 revisions the adopted governance workflow already uses
architecture.rollback: Delete the workflow; the suite remains runnable locally with python3 standard/conformance.py --all

validation.evidence: The suite the workflow runs passes locally at the accepted base with 4 canonical documents and 30 adversarial rejections
Every action in the workflow is pinned to a full 40-character revision, matching the Node 24 pins used by the adopted governance workflow
The managed gate passes with the change resolving to exactly one infrastructure ticket
